partners.mechanism_chain: EFNB1 (HGNC:3073) —DISRUPTS→ Ephrin signaling pathway (GO:0038061); Ephrin signaling pathway (GO:0038061) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal skull morphology (HP:0005470); RAC1 (HGNC:9742) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030030); Regulation of actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030030) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). Haploinsufficiency of EFNB1 disrupts ephrin signaling, leading to abnormal skull morphology in craniofrontonasal syndrome. Gain-of-function mutations in RAC1 disrupt the regulation of the actin cytoskeleton, resulting in intellectual disability in autosomal dominant intellectual disability 48. While RAC1 is a key regulator of cell migration and cytoskeletal dynamics, and EFNB1 signaling impacts cell-cell interactions and tissue patterning, their distinct roles converge on cellular processes fundamental to both craniofacial development and neuronal function.

partners.mechanism_chain: EFNB1 (HGNC:3095) —DISRUPTS→ Ephrin signaling pathway; Ephrin signaling pathway —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal head shape (HP:0000239); TIAM1 (HGNC:11706) —DISRUPTS→ Rac GTPase signaling pathway; Rac GTPase signaling pathway —LEADS_TO→ Delayed speech and language development (HP:0000750); Rac GTPase signaling pathway —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250).
